text:
Aqueous copper(II) sulfate is electrolysed using copper electrodes.
Which statement is correct?
A
Oxygen gas is produced at the positive electrode.
B
The blue colour of the solution gradually fades.
C
The concentration of copper ions in the solution stays the same.
D
The mass of the negative electrode decreases.

options.label: A
options.text: Oxygen gas is produced at the positive electrode.

options.label: B
options.text: The blue colour of the solution gradually fades.

options.label: C
options.text: The concentration of copper ions in the solution stays the same.

options.label: D
options.text: The mass of the negative electrode decreases.
